scope: Calls the retrieval endpoint and standalone evidence assessor. Does not call the support-draft endpoint or create a human-review task.

results.question: How long does the initial review of a reported duplicate charge take?

required_answer_facts: A reported duplicate charge is reviewed within 2 business days.
claims_to_avoid: The final resolution or credit posting is guaranteed within 2 business days.

chunks.title: Synthetic Duplicate Charge Review Policy
chunks.text: A reported duplicate charge is reviewed within 2 business days. If the charge is confirmed to be a duplicate, the duplicate charge is reversed. Support must not promise a reversal before the review confirms that the charge is a duplicate.

chunks.title: Synthetic Billing Dispute Review SLA
chunks.text: Billing disputes require human review for final resolution. The initial review window is not a guaranteed deadline for final resolution or for a credit to appear in a payment account. This synthetic policy does not specify a fixed final-resolution or credit-posting date.

chunks.title: Synthetic Account Recovery Procedure
chunks.text: A report of suspected unauthorized access, or a request to bypass multi-factor authentication, requires human security review. Do not promise that access will be restored before the required review is complete.
